hotels.description: Spread across 62 acres of tropical gardens along Hawai‘i Island’s Kohala Coast, Hilton Waikoloa Village is a resort on a remarkable scale. Move between the towers, pools and oceanfront experiences by on-site tram, or cruise through the protected four-acre lagoon by canal boat. Then, step onto its white-sand shores, where wave-free waters are home to tropical fish and wild green sea turtles. The resort is also home to Dolphin Quest Hawai‘i, the Big Island’s only interactive dolphin facility, where guided encounters take place in an ocean-fed tidal pool. Three distinct pool areas offer something for every mood, from Kona Pool’s 175-foot waterslide to the family-friendly Kohala Pool and the adults-only Ocean Tower Pool. Golfers are sorted with a championship course, and when you’re ready to slow down, Kohala Spa offers restorative treatments and wellness experiences. When hunger calls, choose from 12 restaurants and lounges serving everything from fresh island flavours and Italian favourites to poolside snacks and cocktails. As evening falls, you might like to discover the resort's Legends of Hawai‘i Lū‘au, where traditional Polynesian dining, fire dancing and storytelling unfold against the Hawaiian sunset.
